CheckTitle: Log Groups with no AWS KMS keys associated
Description: Log Groups were detected without an AWS KMS key associated with them. CloudWatch Logs uses server-side encryption with 256-bit Advanced Encryption Standard Galois/Counter Mode by default to encrypt data at rest. Encryption using AWS KMS is enabled at the log group level, by associating a KMS key with a log group and all newly ingested data for the log group is encrypted using this key.

Recommendation.Text: Associate KMS Keys with CloudWatch log groups.
